message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server Available in Italy North

Body.Content:
Azure Arc-enabled SQL Server is now available in Italy North, enabling you to connect SQL Server instances to Azure Arc and take advantage of Azure-based inventory, governance, security, assessment, and license management capabilities.

Learn more.
